periods.name: 半圆魔法阵操作
periods.description: Carbuncle uses the half-circle array and Endymira hypothesis to retrieve her left half from a timeless gap. Later Carbuncle instructs Lucifelia to reopen it so Kinji can throw a missile into the interdimensional space, and Hilda closes it.
